description: The menu's entries: built-in sections (`Section` names) and custom pages (`page:<id>`) in the user's order (`prefs.menuOrder`, docs/SHARING.md). `input.order` is the saved order, `input.pages` the ids of the existing custom pages; `expected` the menu from top to bottom. Unknown ids are ignored, entries not in the order come last (sections first, then pages).

cases.name: No saved order: sections, then pages
The user's order; a deleted page in it is ignored, missing entries come last
An unknown section from a newer app is ignored
